title: The Australian Visa Application Process Explained
description: 完整答案表、全文段落速覽，以及逐題 Skim、Scan、Read、同義改寫與中伏位分析。

questions.translation: 不是所有簽證申請類別都可以透過某個方式進入或處理。

blocks.text: 題目位置： Not all types of visa applications can be accessed 27 ______
先看段落功能
目標段落：Paragraph 3第一句：
“The first and most important thing to do is to check that the visa you have selected is appropriate to your circumstances.”
中文意思：
第一件也是最重要的事，是檢查你所選的簽證是否適合你的個人情況。
最後一句：
“In general, however, most people will find that they can apply online as our most common types of visas (working-holiday, student, employer-sponsored, etc.) can be accessed over the internet.”
中文意思：
不過，一般而言，大多數人會發現自己可以網上申請，因為最常見的簽證類別，例如工作假期、學生、僱主擔保等，都可以透過互聯網進入申請。
只看首尾句，可以先猜 Paragraph 3 的功能：這段處理「確認簽證類別」以及「是否可網上申請」。
題目出現 “Not all types of visa applications can be accessed”，正好對應這段的提醒。
用題目詞定位
定位詞是：● Not all types● visa applications● accessed掃描 Paragraph 3，可找到兩句相關原文。
第一句：
“Please remember that certain visas are not available to apply for over the internet…”
中文意思：
請記住，某些簽證不能透過互聯網申請。
第二句：
“...our most common types of visas ... can be accessed over the internet.”
中文意思：
我們最常見的簽證類別可以透過互聯網進入申請。
題目用 Not all types，原文用 certain visas are not available，兩者意思相同：部分簽證不能網上申請。
細讀答案句
題目句子：
Not all types of visa applications can be accessed ______原文：
“...most common types of visas ... can be accessed over the internet.”
空格前面已經有 can be accessed，所以答案要填介詞短語。原文中最吻合的是： over the internet完整句子變成： Not all types of visa applications can be accessed over the internet.意思是：並非所有簽證申請都可以透過互聯網進入。
題目 原文Not all types certain visas are not available visa applications visas / types of visas can be can be accessed accessed online over the internet
學生可能會填 online，因為文章多次出現 apply online。不過題目句子是 “can be accessed______”，原文完整搭配是 accessed over the internet。在 Flow-chart Completion 裡，如果原文有完整片語，而且字數符合限制，應優先保留原文搭配。

questions.translation: 熟悉並接受某些條款後，勾選某個方格。

blocks.text: 題目位置： tick the 28 ______ once you have familiarised yourself with, and if you accept, the 29 ______
先看段落功能
目標段落：Paragraph 4第一句：

“Before starting the application process officially (by clicking the Apply Online button), please read all the accompanying guidelines and information about the type of visa application you have chosen to make.”
中文意思：
在正式開始申請程序之前，也就是點擊 Apply Online 按鈕之前，請閱讀你所選簽證申請類別的所有附帶指引和資料。
最後一句：
“It is also necessary to accept the terms and conditions before you continue by checking the I Agree box.”
中文意思：
在繼續之前，你也必須接受條款及細則，方法是勾選 I Agree 方格。
只看首尾句，可以知道 Paragraph 4 主要講正式開始申請前要做的事：閱讀指引、接受條款、勾選方格。題目中的 “tick” 和 “accept” 直接把我們帶到最後一句。
用題目詞定位
題目定位詞：● tick● accept● guidelines● terms● box原文用的是：
“checking the I Agree box”
這裡 checking 對應題目的 tick。英式考試語境裡，tick a box 和 check a box 都表示「勾選方格」。
細讀答案句
原文關鍵句：
“It is also necessary to accept the terms and conditions before you continue by checking the I Agree box.”
中文意思：
在繼續之前，你也必須接受條款及細則，方法是勾選 I Agree 方格。
題目句子要填的是： tick the ______所以答案需要是一個可以被 tick 的東西。原文中被 checking 的對象是： the I Agree box題目已有 “the”，但答案仍可寫 I Agree box，完整句子是： tick the I Agree box這是原文直接重現。
題目 原文tick checking the box the I Agree box once you accept before you continue by accepting start the actual application before you continue process
不要填 terms and conditions 到 Q28，因為 terms and conditions 是你接受的內容，不是你勾選的方格。題目問 “tick the ______”，所以答案必須是 I Agree box。

questions.translation: 如果你已熟悉並接受某些內容，就勾選 I Agree 方格。

blocks.text: 題目位置： tick the 28 ______ once you have familiarised yourself with, and if you accept, the 29 ______
先看段落功能
目標段落：Paragraph 4第一句：

“Before starting the application process officially (by clicking the Apply Online button), please read all the accompanying guidelines and information about the type of visa application you have chosen to make.”
中文意思：
在正式開始申請程序之前，請閱讀你所選簽證類別的所有相關指引和資料。
最後一句：
“It is also necessary to accept the terms and conditions before you continue by checking the I Agree box.”
中文意思：
在繼續之前，你也必須接受條款及細則，方法是勾選 I Agree 方格。
這段首句講 read guidelines，末句講 accept terms and conditions。題目同時出現 familiarised yourself with 和 accept，所以答案自然在這一句。
用題目詞定位
定位詞：● familiarised yourself with● accept● I Agree● terms原文直接出現：
“accept the terms and conditions”
細讀答案句
原文：
“It is also necessary to accept the terms and conditions before you continue by checking the I Agree box.”
題目：
if you accept, the ______空格需要填「被接受的內容」。原文中被 accept 的對象是： the terms and conditions題目已有 “the”，所以答案寫： terms and conditions
題目 原文if you accept necessary to accept the 29 ______ the terms and conditions tick the I Agree box checking the I Agree box
Q28 和 Q29 很近，容易互換。判斷方法很簡單： tick 的對象是 box； accept 的對象是 terms and conditions。
看動詞搭配比只看名詞更安全。

questions.translation: 小心填寫表格，並以某種方式回答所有問題。

blocks.text: 題目位置： Fill in the form carefully and answer all questions 30 ______
先看段落功能
目標段落：Paragraph 6第一句：
“Applicants for Long-Stay Business visas will also be asked for details of their business sponsor.”
中文意思：
長期商務簽證申請人也會被要求提供其商務擔保人的資料。
最後一句：

“Once you have completed all the screens that form part of the application form, answering all questions as truly and honestly as possible, you will be given the opportunity to review the information you have supplied and print a copy of the visa application for reference purposes if you wish.”
中文意思：
當你完成申請表所有 screens，並盡可能真實和誠實地回答所有問題後，你將有機會檢查自己提供的資料；如有需要，也可列印一份簽證申請副本作參考用途。
只看首尾句，可以知道 Paragraph 6 講不同簽證類別的補充資料，以及完成表格後的 review /print。Q30 的 “answer all questions” 直接出現在最後一句。
用題目詞定位
定位詞：● answer all questions● carefully● form原文直接有：
“answering all questions as truly and honestly as possible”
細讀答案句
原文完整片語是：
“as truly and honestly as possible”
但題目限制是： NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER如果完整抄 as truly and honestly as possible，共有 6 個 words，超出限制。
題目句子是： answer all questions ______所以最適合填入的是副詞片語： truly and honestly
完整句子：
answer all questions truly and honestly意思是：真實而誠實地回答所有問題。
題目 原文answer all answering all questions questions carefully as truly and honestly as possible 30 ______ truly and honestly
這題最容易錯在字數限制。原文完整片語很明顯，但 as truly and honestly as possible 超出三個字。IELTS 填空題常常要從完整片語中抽取符合文法和字數限制的部分。這裡填 truly and honestly 已保留核心意思，也符合三字限制。

questions.translation: 最多預留大約多少時間完成表格。

blocks.text: 題目位置： Allow yourself approximately 31 ______ at most to complete the form
先看段落功能
目標段落：Paragraph 5第一句：
“Once you have moved on to the actual application form itself, there will be between 5 and 9 short screens to complete, depending on the type of visa you are applying for.”
中文意思：
當你進入實際申請表後，視乎所申請的簽證類別，你需要完成 5 至 9 個短 screens。
最後一句：

“All applications will ask you for your personal details, namely your passport number, travel document details, name and current place of residence, contact information, declarations with respect to your health and character, etc.”
中文意思：
所有申請都會要求你提供個人資料，例如護照號碼、旅行證件資料、姓名、現居地、聯絡資料，以及關於健康和品格的聲明等。
首句講 screens 數量，段中講每個 screen 大約 4 分鐘，最後句講所有申請都需要個人資料。Q31問完成表格總時間，目標段落明顯是 Paragraph 5。
用題目詞定位
定位詞：● approximately● at most● complete the form● 4 minutes原文相關句：
“As a rough estimate, allow yourself about 4 minutes to fill in the information on each screen.”
中文意思：
粗略估計，每個 screen 可預留約 4 分鐘填寫資料。
下一句：
“On this basis, it should take you a maximum of about 40 minutes to complete the form.”
中文意思：
按此推算，完成表格最多大約需要 40 分鐘。
細讀答案句
題目說： approximately ______ at most原文說：
“a maximum of about 40 minutes”
這裡：● approximately 對應 about● at most 對應 a maximum of● complete the form 原文完全重現所以答案是： 40 minutes雖然原文有 about 40 minutes，題目已經有 approximately，因此填 40 minutes 最乾淨。
題目 原文approximately about at most a maximum of complete the form complete the form 31 ______ 40 minutes
不要填 about 40 minutes 也可以，但題目已有 approximately，填 “approximately about 40 minutes” 會有語意重複。正式答題寫 40 minutes 已足夠，也符合字數限制。

questions.translation: 或者說，每個甚麼項目大約用 4 分鐘。

blocks.text: 題目位置： or 4 minutes for 32 ______
先看段落功能
目標段落：Paragraph 5第一句：
“Once you have moved on to the actual application form itself, there will be between 5 and 9 short screens to complete, depending on the type of visa you are applying for.”
中文意思：
當你進入實際申請表後，視乎簽證類別，你需要完成 5 至 9 個短 screens。
最後一句：

“All applications will ask you for your personal details, namely your passport number, travel document details, name and current place of residence, contact information, declarations with respect to your health and character, etc.”
中文意思：
所有申請都會要求你提供個人資料，包括護照號碼、旅行證件資料、姓名、現居地、聯絡資料，以及健康和品格聲明等。
這段處理 screens 數量和每屏所需時間。Q32 的 “4 minutes” 是非常強的數字定位詞。
用題目詞定位
定位詞：● 4 minutes● for● screen原文：
“As a rough estimate, allow yourself about 4 minutes to fill in the information on each screen.”
中文意思：
粗略估計，每個 screen 可預留約 4 分鐘填寫資料。
細讀答案句
題目：
4 minutes for ______原文：
“4 minutes ... on each screen”
因為題目用 for，原文用 on，但搭配可以改寫成： 4 minutes for each screen
答案：
each screen
題目 原文4 minutes for 4 minutes to fill in 32 ______ each screen complete the form fill in the information
不要填 5 and 9 short screens，因為那是 screens 的總數範圍，不是每 4 分鐘對應的單位。題目問的是 “4 minutes for what?”，原文答案是 each screen。

questions.translation: 對你已輸入的資料進行某個動作。

blocks.text: 題目位置： 33 ______ the details you have entered
先看段落功能
目標段落：Paragraph 6第一句：
“Applicants for Long-Stay Business visas will also be asked for details of their business sponsor.”
中文意思：
長期商務簽證申請人也會被要求提供其商務擔保人的資料。
最後一句：

“Once you have completed all the screens that form part of the application form, answering all questions as truly and honestly as possible, you will be given the opportunity to review the information you have supplied and print a copy of the visa application for reference purposes if you wish.”
中文意思：
當你完成所有構成申請表的 screens，並盡可能真實和誠實地回答所有問題後，你將有機會檢查自己提供的資料；如有需要，也可以列印一份簽證申請副本作參考用途。
這段後半講填表完成後的下一步：review and print。Q33 直接來自最後一句。
用題目詞定位
定位詞：● details you have entered● print a copy● application原文：
“review the information you have supplied”
題目把 information you have supplied 改寫成 details you have entered。
細讀答案句
題目：
______ the details you have entered原文：
“review the information you have supplied”
所以答案是： review完整流程是： Review the details you have entered...意思是：檢查你已輸入的資料。
題目 原文details information you have entered you have supplied 33 ______ review if you wish, print a copy print a copy ... if you wish
不要填 print，因為 print 是下一個動作。題目先說 “the details you have entered”，這是檢查資料，不是列印資料。真正動詞是 review。

questions.translation: 如有需要，列印一份申請副本作某種用途。

blocks.text: 題目位置： print a copy of the application for your 34 ______
先看段落功能
目標段落：Paragraph 6第一句：
“Applicants for Long-Stay Business visas will also be asked for details of their business sponsor.”
中文意思：
長期商務簽證申請人也會被要求提供商務擔保人的資料。
最後一句：

“Once you have completed all the screens that form part of the application form, answering all questions as truly and honestly as possible, you will be given the opportunity to review the information you have supplied and print a copy of the visa application for reference purposes if you wish.”
中文意思：
完成所有申請表 screens 並誠實回答問題後，你將有機會檢查資料；如有需要，也可以列印一份簽證申請副本作參考用途。
用題目詞定位
定位詞：● print a copy● application● for your原文：
“print a copy of the visa application for reference purposes if you wish”
細讀答案句
原文完整片語是： for reference purposes題目改寫成： for your ______如果要令題目句子最自然，答案應是： reference
完整句子：
print a copy of the application for your reference意思是：列印一份申請副本，以供自己參考。
題目 原文print a copy of the application print a copy of the visa application for your reference for reference purposes if you wish if you wish
這題有一點語法細節。原文片語是 reference purposes，但題目已經寫了 for your。英文自然搭配是 for your reference。所以我建議答案填 reference。如果某份答案表採用較機械的原文片語，可能會接受 reference purposes；但就題目空格文法而言，reference 是較乾淨的答案。

questions.translation: 等系統提示後，輸入付款資料。

blocks.text: 題目位置： Wait to be 35 ______, then enter your payment information.
先看段落功能
目標段落：Paragraph 7第一句：
“You are now ready to submit your application, but there is one more thing you must do before the option to submit appears – make the payment.”
中文意思：
你現在已準備好提交申請，但在提交選項出現之前，還有一件事必須做：付款。
最後一句：
“Please follow any other requirements as stipulated on the screen as special pre-entry conditions must be met for some types of visas.”
中文意思：
請按照畫面上列明的其他要求辦理，因為某些簽證類別必須符合特別入境前條件。
只看首尾句，可以知道 Paragraph 7 是「付款與提交」段落。Q35 的 payment information 自然定位到這裡。
用題目詞定位
定位詞：● payment information● enter● wait to be原文：
“You will be prompted to enter your payment information after you have confirmed that all the details entered in your application are, to the best of your knowledge, true.”
中文意思：
當你確認申請中輸入的所有資料據你所知均屬真實後，系統會提示你輸入付款資料。
細讀答案句
題目：
Wait to be ______, then enter your payment information.原文：
“You will be prompted to enter your payment information…”
被動結構完全吻合：● 題目：be ______● 原文：be prompted所以答案是： prompted
題目 原文Wait to be prompted You will be prompted enter your payment information enter your payment information after confirming details after you have confirmed all the details
不要填 confirmed。confirmed 是你在付款前要做的另一件事：確認資料真實。題目問 “Wait to be______, then enter payment information”，系統提示的動作是 prompted。

questions.translation: 銀行接受付款後，記下自動產生的某個號碼。

blocks.text: 題目位置： Record your 36 ______, which will be generated once your bank has accepted the payment request.
先看段落功能
目標段落：Paragraph 7第一句：
“You are now ready to submit your application, but there is one more thing you must do before the option to submit appears – make the payment.”
中文意思：
你現在已準備好提交申請，但提交選項出現之前，還有一件事要做：付款。
最後一句：
“Please follow any other requirements as stipulated on the screen as special pre-entry conditions must be met for some types of visas.”
中文意思：
請按照畫面上列明的其他要求辦理，因為某些簽證類別必須符合特別入境前條件。
這段集中處理付款、提交、付款後產生的編號，以及健康表格。Q36 的 “generated once your bank has accepted” 直接定位到付款成功後的句子。
用題目詞定位
定位詞：● generated● bank accepts payment● record● number原文：
“When the bank accepts payment, a Transaction Reference Number will be automatically generated.”
中文意思：
當銀行接受付款後，一個 Transaction Reference Number 會自動產生。
下一句：
“You should make a note of this and keep it safe…”
中文意思：
你應該記下這個號碼並妥善保存。
細讀答案句
題目：
Record your ______, which will be generated once your bank has accepted the payment request.原文：
“When the bank accepts payment, a Transaction Reference Number will be automatically generated.”
答案是： Transaction Reference Number字數計算：● Transaction = 1● Reference = 2● Number = 3符合 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。

題目 原文Record your make a note of this generated once your bank has When the bank accepts payment, ... will be accepted payment automatically generated payment request payment 36 ______ Transaction Reference Number
不要填 payment information，因為 payment information 是你輸入的信用卡或付款資料；題目問的是付款成功後自動產生並要保存的編號。真正答案是 Transaction Reference Number。
四、Questions 37–38：Multiple Choice

questions.answer: C — a globally recognised credit card and a passport valid for at least another half a
questions.answerKey: C — a globally recognised credit card and a passport valid for at least another half a
questions.prompt: Before starting the online application process, all applicants are expected to have...
questions.translation: 在開始網上申請程序前，所有申請人都應該具備甚麼？

blocks.text: year
這題考 all applicants。只要某項只適用於某一類簽證，就不能選作所有申請人都要有的東西。
先看段落功能
目標段落：Paragraph 1第一句：
“Applications for Australian visas are now accepted online.”
中文意思：
澳洲簽證申請現在接受網上提交。
最後一句：
“In order to proceed online, you should also have up-to-date internet browsers loaded on your computer and an internationally accepted credit card to pay the application charge.”
中文意思：
為了能夠網上繼續申請，你也應該在電腦上安裝最新版本的互聯網瀏覽器，並持有一張國際通用的信用卡，用來支付申請費。
只看首尾句，可以猜到 Paragraph 1 是「申請前準備清單」。Q37 問 before starting，正好定位到這段。
用題目詞定位
定位詞：● Before starting● all applicants● passport● credit card● nomination approval原文開頭列出：
“your current passport (valid for at least 6 months at the date of application)”
中文意思：
你目前的護照，在申請日期起至少仍有 6 個月有效期。
另外：
“your sponsor and associated nomination approval number or transaction reference number [(ii) only applies to Long-Stay Temporary Business Visa applicants].”
中文意思：
你的擔保人及相關提名批准號碼或交易參考號碼；這一項只適用於長期臨時商務簽證申請人。
還有：
“an internationally accepted credit card”
中文意思：
一張國際通用的信用卡。
細讀答案句

正確答案 C： a globally recognised credit card and a passport valid for at least another half a year.這裡的改寫是：● globally recognised credit card = internationally accepted credit card● valid for at least another half a year = valid for at least 6 months這兩項是所有網上申請人都應準備的基本要求。
A their sponsor and nomination approval or transaction reference number.錯在範圍。原文清楚說這項：
“only applies to Long-Stay Temporary Business Visa applicants”
所以它只適用於 Long-Stay Temporary Business Visa applicants，不適用於所有申請人。
B a passport that is six months or less old and a valid credit card.這裡把護照有效期誤改成護照年齡。原文說護照要 valid for at least 6 months，意思是申請時仍有至少 6 個月有效期；B 說護照是 “six months or less old”，即護照簽發不足六個月，完全不是同一要求。
C a globally recognised credit card and a passport valid for at least another half a year.正確。它準確改寫了 internationally accepted credit card 和 valid for at least 6 months。

D a valid credit card, passport with six or more months validity left, and your nomination approval or transaction reference number.這個選項前半正確，但後半把只適用於 Long-Stay Temporary Business Visa 的資料要求套到所有申請人身上。題目問 all applicants，所以 D 的範圍過大。

正確選項 C 原文globally recognised credit card internationally accepted credit card passport valid for at least another half a passport valid for at least 6 months year before starting application before you embark on the application process
D 很有迷惑性，因為它包含了正確的 passport 和 credit card，也包含原文出現過的 nomination /transaction reference number。問題在 all applicants。IELTS MCQ 常把「某類申請人需要的東西」放進「所有人都需要」的選項中。看到 only applies to 這類限制，就要立刻警覺。

questions.answer: D — it will, in most cases, then be handled electronically, and you will be told

questions.prompt: Once an online application has been submitted,...
questions.translation: 一旦網上申請已經提交，之後會怎樣？

blocks.text: whether or not it has been successful within the timeframe stated onscreen.
先看段落功能
這題需要看 Paragraph 7 和 Paragraph 8。
Paragraph 7 第一句：
“You are now ready to submit your application, but there is one more thing you must do before the option to submit appears – make the payment.”
中文意思：
你現在已準備好提交申請，但提交選項出現前還要先付款。
Paragraph 7 最後一句：
“Please follow any other requirements as stipulated on the screen as special pre-entry conditions must be met for some types of visas.”
中文意思：
請按照畫面列明的其他要求辦理，因為某些簽證類別必須符合特別入境前條件。
Paragraph 8 第一句：

“Most applications will be processed electronically and notification will be sent by post or email (whichever method you selected on your application form) within the time frame outlined onscreen during your application.”
中文意思：
大多數申請會以電子方式處理，通知會按照你在申請表中選擇的方法，以郵寄或電郵發出，時間在你申請時畫面所列的期限之內。
Paragraph 8 最後一句：
“Occasionally, it may be necessary for a representative from the immigration department to contact you, and, in some cases, further health checks, information, or a formal interview may be required.”
中文意思：
偶爾，移民部門代表可能需要聯絡你；在某些情況下，可能需要進一步健康檢查、資料或正式面試。
題目問提交後的情況，所以主要證據在 Paragraph 8 第一和最後句，並要配合 Paragraph 7 的health forms 條件。
用題目詞定位
定位詞：● Once submitted● processed electronically● download and print forms● timeframe● successful原文可定位到：
“Most applications will be processed electronically…”
以及：
“notification will be sent by post or email…”
還有 Paragraph 7：
“you may be prompted to download and print certain health forms, but only if you are applying from overseas”
細讀正確答案
正確選項 D： it will, in most cases, then be handled electronically, and you will be told whether or not it has been successful within the timeframe stated onscreen.原文：
“Most applications will be processed electronically and notification will be sent by post or email ... within the time frame outlined onscreen during your application.”

D 中：● in most cases = Most applications● handled electronically = processed electronically● you will be told = notification will be sent● within the timeframe stated onscreen = within the time frame outlined onscreen所以 D 是完整支援選項。
A your visa will be approved or rejected within a maximum of 10 working days.錯在把 student visa 的時間套到所有申請。原文說：
“For student visas, that’s about 10 working days.”
10 working days 只屬於 student visas，不是所有簽證。
B it is possible for any applicant to be required to download and print further forms and follow the associated instructions.這個選項的問題在 any applicant。原文說：
“you may be prompted to download and print certain health forms, but only if you are applying from overseas”
即使是海外申請，也只是 may be prompted，不是任何申請人都有這個可能性。B 的範圍太闊。
C applicants from outside Australia will be required to download and complete further forms.原文說的是：
“may be prompted”
不是所有海外申請人都必須下載。C 把可能性改成必然性，所以錯。
D正確。它最完整概括了 submitted application 後的通常處理方式。

選項 D 原文in most cases Most applications handled electronically processed electronically you will be told notification will be sent timeframe stated time frame outlined onscreen onscreen successful / not notification of application result successful
B 和 C 都利用了 Paragraph 7 的 health forms。真正控制答案的是兩個限制： 1. may be prompted：只是可能； 2. only if you are applying from overseas：只限海外申請這種情況。
B 把範圍擴成 any applicant；C 把 may 改成 will be required。兩者都越過原文。
五、Questions 39–40：Choose TWO Correct Letters
Choose the TWO correct letters from A, B, C, D and E.這種題不能只找一個答案。每個選項都要獨立驗證，而且答案通常分散在同一段不同句子。這組題主要來自 Paragraph 8。

questions.translation: 學生簽證、旅遊簽證和工作假期簽證都應該少於兩星期內有結果。

blocks.text: 選項 A Student visas, tourist visas and working-holiday visas should all take under two weeks to be approved or rejected.
先看段落功能
目標段落：Paragraph 8第一句：
“Most applications will be processed electronically and notification will be sent by post or email ... within the time frame outlined onscreen during your application.”
中文意思：
大多數申請會以電子方式處理，通知會在申請時畫面列明的期限內，以郵寄或電郵發出。
最後一句：
“Occasionally, it may be necessary for a representative from the immigration department to contact you, and, in some cases, further health checks, information, or a formal interview may be required.”
中文意思：
偶爾，移民部門代表可能需要聯絡你；某些情況下，可能需要進一步健康檢查、資料或正式面試。
Paragraph 8 是處理時間和後續要求的段落，A 的時間比較自然定位到這裡。
用題目詞定位
定位詞：● student visas● tourist visas● working-holiday visas● under two weeks原文：
“For student visas, that’s about 10 working days. Tourist visas are normally finalised in less than two weeks. Working-holiday visas take no more than 2 days and so on.”
中文意思：
學生簽證大約需要 10 個工作天。旅遊簽證通常少於兩星期完成。工作假期簽證不超過 2 天，如此等等。
細讀選項問題

A 的問題在 under two weeks 這個統一描述。原文對三類簽證給出的時間不同：● Student visas：about 10 working days● Tourist visas：less than two weeks● Working-holiday visas：no more than 2 days 10 working days 通常接近兩個工作星期，原文沒有說 student visas under two weeks。因此 A把三種簽證壓成同一條時間規則，證據不夠精準。
判斷A 不選。
它和原文有相關資料，但 “all take under two weeks” 對 student visas 來說並不穩妥。
選項 B It is a requirement of Australian immigration that all those applying for a visa undertake a formal interview.
中文意思：
澳洲移民部門要求所有簽證申請人都要進行正式面試。
定位詞：● all● formal interview原文：
“Occasionally, it may be necessary for a representative from the immigration department to contact you, and, in some cases, further health checks, information, or a formal interview may be required.”
中文意思：
偶爾，移民部門代表可能需要聯絡你；某些情況下，可能需要進一步健康檢查、資料或正式面試。
原文是：● Occasionally● may be necessary● in some cases● may be required選項 B 是：● all● requirement● undertake a formal interview判斷B 錯。
原文只說某些情況下可能需要面試，選項改成所有申請人都必須面試。這是典型的 some → all範圍擴大錯誤。
選項 C Officials from the immigration department may conduct health checks on and/or hold an interview with certain applicants.
中文意思：
移民部門官員可能會對某些申請人進行健康檢查，及／或安排面試。
先看段落功能
目標段落：Paragraph 8第一句：
“Most applications will be processed electronically and notification will be sent by post or email ... within the time frame outlined onscreen during your application.”
中文意思：
大多數申請會以電子方式處理，通知會在畫面列明期限內寄出或電郵發出。
最後一句：
“Occasionally, it may be necessary for a representative from the immigration department to contact you, and, in some cases, further health checks, information, or a formal interview may be required.”
中文意思：
偶爾，移民部門代表可能需要聯絡你；在某些情況下，可能需要進一步健康檢查、資料或正式面試。
這題明顯定位到最後一句。
用題目詞定位
定位詞：● immigration department● health checks● interview● certain applicants原文直接有：
“a representative from the immigration department”
以及：
“further health checks, information, or a formal interview may be required”
細讀答案句

選項 C 說： Officials from the immigration department may conduct health checks on and/or hold an interview with certain applicants.原文雖然沒有逐字說 officials conduct checks，但意思吻合：● Officials from the immigration department = a representative from the immigration department● may = may be necessary / may be required● health checks = further health checks● interview = formal interview● certain applicants = in some cases判斷C 正確。
它保留了原文的可能性和範圍限制：不是所有人，只是某些情況下可能需要。

選項 C 原文Officials from the immigration department a representative from the immigration department may may be necessary / may be required certain applicants in some cases health checks further health checks hold an interview a formal interview may be required
C 的 “conduct health checks” 比原文 slightly more active。原文說 health checks may be required，沒有詳細說誰親自進行。但在此語境下，immigration department 要求健康檢查或面試，選項 C 是合理概括，沒有改變核心意思。
選項 D Working-holiday visa applicants can expect to receive a comparatively fast confirmation of whether or not their application has been successful.
中文意思：
工作假期簽證申請人可預期較快收到申請成功與否的確認。
先看段落功能
目標段落：Paragraph 8第一句：
“Most applications will be processed electronically and notification will be sent by post or email ... within the time frame outlined onscreen during your application.”
中文意思：
大多數申請會以電子方式處理，並在申請時畫面列出的期限內透過郵寄或電郵通知。
最後一句：
“Occasionally, it may be necessary for a representative from the immigration department to contact you, and, in some cases, further health checks, information, or a formal interview may be required.”
中文意思：
偶爾，移民部門代表可能需要聯絡你；某些情況下，可能需要進一步健康檢查、資料或正式面試。
D 問 working-holiday 的處理時間，仍在 Paragraph 8。
用題目詞定位
定位詞：● Working-holiday visas● fast● confirmation● successful原文：
“Working-holiday visas take no more than 2 days and so on.”
中文意思：
工作假期簽證不超過 2 天。
前文比較：
“For student visas, that’s about 10 working days. Tourist visas are normally finalised in less than two weeks.”
中文意思：
學生簽證大約 10 個工作天；旅遊簽證通常少於兩星期完成。
細讀答案句

D 的 comparatively fast 不是原文逐字，但由三個時間比較可直接推出：● Student visas：about 10 working days● Tourist visas：less than two weeks● Working-holiday visas：no more than 2 days工作假期簽證的 no more than 2 days 明顯比另外兩種快，所以 “comparatively fast confirmation” 是合理概括。
判斷D 正確。
它沒有誇大成 “immediate” 或 “guaranteed approval”；只是說相對較快收到成功與否的確認，符合原文 “take no more than 2 days”。

選項 D 原文working-holiday visa Working-holiday visas applicants comparatively fast no more than 2 days, compared with 10 working days / less than two weeks confirmation notification whether successful visa finalised / notification of result
D 的答案需要比較。原文沒有直接寫 “fast”，但列出三類簽證時間後，working-holiday 的 2 days明顯較短。這是 IELTS 可接受的短距離推論。
選項 E Successful visa applicants have a limited amount of time within which to finalise their travel plans and arrive in Australia.
中文意思：
成功獲簽者有一段有限時間，必須在該時限內完成旅行計劃並抵達澳洲。
這個選項涉及：● successful visa applicants● limited amount of time● finalise travel plans● arrive in Australia文章沒有提供這些資料。Paragraph 8 只說處理時間和通知方式，沒有說獲批後必須何時抵達澳洲。
判斷E 不選。
它聽起來像簽證條件可能會有的內容，但本文沒有支援。不能用常識補入。

paragraphs.summary: 交代網上申請澳洲簽證前需要準備的基本文件和工具。
說明這份 guide 的目的：幫助申請人了解流程和步驟。
第一步：確認所選簽證是否適合；並提醒有些簽證不能網上申請。
正式開始申請前，閱讀Page 1 指引，並接受terms and conditions。
進入主申請表：完成 5–9個 screens，每頁約 4 分鐘，最多約 40 分鐘；填寫個人資料。
不同簽證類別需要補充不同資料；完成後可 review及 print a copy。
付款、取得 Transaction Reference Number、提交申請；海外申請人可能需要下載 health forms。
申請後的處理方式、通知時間，以及可能需要補交資料、健康檢查或面試。

sourceNotes: **Q34 小備註：**原文完整片語是 for reference purposes。題目句子是 “for your _____”，放回句子時 reference 最自然；如果答案表偏向原文完整片語，可能會寫 reference purposes。我會建議學生在正式答題寫 reference，並知道原文定位來自 reference purposes。
Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the passage for each answer.這代表答案必須來自原文，不能自己改寫成完全不同的詞。這組是流程圖題，做法要看順序：題目由申請前 → 點擊 Apply Online → 填表 → review → payment → submit，基本上跟文章段落順序一致。
